description: Fires when one caller_hash hits more than 20 admission denials inside 30 minutes. Typical patterns: a misconfigured agent retrying a denied tool call, or an explore-the-perimeter probe by a compromised account.
query:
Provenex_Receipt_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30m)
| extend tcc = parse_json(policy_s).tool_call_control
| mv-expand decision = tcc.decisions to typeof(dynamic)
| where tostring(decision.decision) == "deny"
| summarize deny_count = count() by caller = tostring(caller_hash_s), bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where deny_count > 20
